name: Confirmed carry unwind
preconditions: Wide Japan-foreign rate differential, low FX volatility, crowded short JPY positioning
trigger: BOJ hawkish surprise, US growth/rate shock, intervention or exogenous risk event
confirmations: JPY +1% or more; at least two of MXN/AUD/NZD/BRL weaken; equities down; VIX +3 points
markets_to_review: JPY crosses, high-beta FX, Nikkei/TOPIX banks, US tech, VIX, crypto
invalidation: JPY retraces while credit stays benign and carry currencies recover

name: Growth-scare unwind
preconditions: Carry crowding plus high sensitivity to US macro data
trigger: Weak payrolls or other negative growth surprise
confirmations: US 2y/10y yields fall, JPY strengthens, VIX rises, oil weakens
markets_to_review: UST duration, JPY, rate-sensitive equities, oil and EM FX
invalidation: Yields rise or inflation shock dominates

name: Japan-only policy repricing
preconditions: BOJ decision risk without broad global stress
confirmations: JPY and JGB curve move; Japan banks/exporters diverge; VIX and credit remain contained
markets_to_review: JPY, JGBs, Japan bank and exporter/importer baskets
invalidation: Broad risk assets and credit join the move, converting it into systemic stress

name: Official intervention impulse
preconditions: Rapid one-way yen move and escalating official language
trigger: MOF yen purchase or coordinated intervention
confirmations: Abrupt JPY strength, higher implied vol and improved follow-through across Tokyo/London/New York
markets_to_review: USD/JPY, EUR/JPY, AUD/JPY, exporter/importer pairs, options skew
invalidation: Move fades quickly without policy-rate or cross-asset confirmation
status: research rule; intervention timing can be uncertain

name: Dollar-funding stress
preconditions: Heavy offshore dollar needs and constrained dealer balance sheets
trigger: Global cash demand or collateral shock
confirmations: JPY/USD basis widens, broad dollar rises, Treasury liquidity worsens, central-bank swap usage rises
markets_to_review: FX basis, bank equities, UST liquidity, dollar funding and EM assets
status: research rule; not a pure yen carry signal

name: Fast stabilization / reversal
preconditions: Violent initial move with limited credit impairment
trigger: Central-bank communication, benign data or exhaustion of forced selling
confirmations: VIX falls, credit recompresses, equities recover and JPY stops strengthening
markets_to_review: Equity rebound, short-vol normalization, carry re-entry only with strict risk limits
invalidation: Credit and funding measures keep deteriorating
status: research rule; reversal trades have gap risk
